title: GéNaissance Library
description: Tech Lead & Full-Stack Developer. Bilingual digital library in production. Features catalog management, memberships, borrowing system with database concurrency locking, Row Level Security, idempotent emails (Resend), and HelloAsso payments.

title: DOMO-OG
description: Open-source npm library that generates Open Graph images from a JSON config using resvg-wasm without a headless browser (~33 ms per image with incremental caching)

title: AT QR
description: An SaaS Qr code generator. Built in Qr custumization, dynamic QRs, dashboard, analytics. Stripe monthly subscription with webhooks, firebase, vercel nextJS.

title: Ani Bani
description: An app designed for Georgian kids, inspired by 'Duo ABC'. The app will feature interactive lessons, stories, and games to teach children the Georgian alphabet and basic words. The app requires further development.

title: Numbero
description: A feature-rich mobile logic game built with React Native, Expo, and Firebase (142+ downloads on Play Store). Includes zero-click Google Play Games login and leaderboards via a custom Kotlin native module and Expo config plugin, 1v1 multiplayer with anti-cheat validation in Cloud Functions, in-game shop, and rewarded ads.

title: Parsect
description: Converts SVG files into JSON-mapped Canvas Path2D shapes. Provides a toPath2D(map) function to create paths and a drawShapes(paths) to render them. Shapes are raw Canvas objects — fully compatible with native Canvas API methods.

title: Zyrab.dev
description: Built from scratch with no libraries or frameworks, this website features a SPA routing system, I wrote functions to dynamically create and modify DOM elements, providing an efficient, lightweight experience.

title: High Way
description: A simple race survival game built in Unity as a personal request. Players control a car, switching lanes to avoid obstacles by tapping the screen. Features include multiple car skins and smooth touch-based controls.

title: Recepio
description: A React Native app that generates recipe suggestions based on available ingredients. Features a history of generated recipes, favorites. UI fully designed in Figma and implemented, with LLM integration planned.

title: Capital Rent
description: Construction equipment rental platform showcasing available tools, pricing, FAQ, and contact workflows. Built with the DOMO Static Site Generator (SSG) and a custom CMS, achieving 100/100 across all Lighthouse performance metrics.

title: KEI Holding
description: This was my first live project and my introduction to Vue.js. The website is designed for a real estate company to showcase their projects, attract investors, and connect with potential customers.

title: Domo
description: A lightweight DOM helper library designed to simplify element creation and manipulation with a fluent API. Includes a custom router for building SPAs with nested routes and history-based navigation.
